P_sunrise.basis: Conventional Ḥanafī ishrāq interval; scholar to set final value.

P_zenith.basis: Istiwāʾ window before zawāl; scholar to set final value.

P_isfirar.basis: Isfirār convention varies across Ḥanafī timetables (20-40 min); scholar to set final value.

anchor_convention.basis: Scholarly basis is after performing Fajr/Asr; app cannot know performance, so anchors conservatively to prayer-time entry. Scholar to confirm.

fardCurrent.basis: Current Fajr is prayed in its time; the W1 restriction concerns nafl only.

qada.basis: Qaḍāʾ is valid after Fajr entry; restriction concerns nafl only.

janazah.basis: Janāzah is permitted in the extended (nafl-restricted) windows.

causalNafl.basis: Nafl after Fajr entry is makrūh taḥrīmī; the two rakʿahs of the Fajr sunnah are excepted before Fajr is prayed.

pureNafl.basis: Nafl after Fajr entry is makrūh taḥrīmī until the sun has risen.

fardCurrent.basis: Fajr's time ends at sunrise; it is made up as qaḍāʾ after the sun has fully risen. Never rendered as a bare NO (spec §3.6).

qada.basis: Prayer in the three strict times is invalid (ḥadīth of ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir, Muslim 831).

janazah.basis: Disliked if the funeral was ready beforehand; permitted if it became ready within the window.

causalNafl.basis: No nafl in the strict times, causal or otherwise.

pureNafl.basis: No nafl in the strict times.

fardCurrent.basis: No obligatory prayer's window naturally falls at istiwāʾ; defined defensively as PERMITTED (spec §3.3 fn 7).

qada.basis: Prayer in the three strict times is invalid (Muslim 831).

janazah.basis: Disliked if the funeral was ready beforehand; permitted if it became ready within the window.

causalNafl.basis: No nafl in the strict times.

pureNafl.basis: No nafl in the strict times.

fardCurrent.basis: Current Asr is prayed in its time; the W4 restriction concerns nafl only.

janazah.basis: Janāzah is permitted in the extended (nafl-restricted) windows.

causalNafl.basis: Nafl after Asr entry is makrūh taḥrīmī until Maghrib.

pureNafl.basis: Nafl after Asr entry is makrūh taḥrīmī until Maghrib.

fardCurrent.basis: That day's unperformed Asr must still be prayed before Maghrib; valid, though the delay was sinful (spec §3.3 fn 8).
